published_prior_art.cite: ElahiGhasemiKocaoglu2025, Eq. (17), already recovers shifted mechanisms from parent-fixing interventions in the Gaussian model.
No inspected comparator identifies the complete dependent centered residual law by observational residual pushforward.
ElahiGhasemiKocaoglu2025 identifies Gaussian AOIs, not arbitrary postintervention laws under an arbitrary dependent residual distribution.
ElahiGhasemiKocaoglu2025 gives a Gaussian mean-level intervention-target criterion, not a valid value-specific full-law frontier.
ElahiGhasemiKocaoglu2025 and JeunenGilliganLeeMehrotraLalmas2022 are expressly the Gaussian and parentless mean special cases claimed by the proposition.

ChernozhukovFernandezValMelly2013 supplies functional-limit and exchangeable-bootstrap theory for regression counterfactual distributions; the generated-residual recursion is distinct but the stated question remains broad.

novelty_flags.label: Proposition 1 and related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: Jeunen et al. (2022) has no Theorem 3; its relevant published identification results are Theorems 1 and 2, so every reference to its “Theorem 3” must be corrected.

novelty_flags.label: Proposition 1
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposition is explicitly a recovery of the already-published Gaussian and parentless mean cases, so it is a regression check rather than a novel standalone result.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed necessity fails for the one-treatment root DAG: with R empty and A_full=E, Pobs identifies q=empty and Pfull identifies every do(X=x), yet C(R,Q)=0 solely because its first conjunct demands an r in R leaving the root free.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1
soundness_flags.one_line: “Every smooth theta” is undefined because b is only bounded Borel, while uniform l-infinity(Q x R) inference is not meaningful from smoothness exponents alone when Q has no compactness, metric, entropy, or target-value regularity specification.

source_verification_receipts.version: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, October 2025
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 2 is an iff Gaussian-AOI criterion requiring P[Y|do(X)] and, for every treatment Xi, a regime Si with Xi not in Si and Pa(Xi) contained in Si; Eq. (17) recovers a shifted treatment mechanism.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 3–4, Theorems 1–2; p. 8, Conclusions & Future Work
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings paper contains Theorems 1 and 2, not Theorem 3. Theorem 2 identifies conditional single-treatment effects in the symmetric Gaussian ANM; the conclusion explicitly identifies non-zero-mean multivariate Gaussian noise as a future-work relaxation.
Theorem 1 identifies E[Y|do(X1,...,XK)] from observational and singleton-intervention distributions under an ordered additive SCM with arbitrary-covariance Gaussian noise.
The paper develops gID for arbitrary collections of observational and experimental distributions and proves its procedure sound and complete.
MIC(G) is a graph-level minimum intervention cover sufficient for all graph-identifiable effects, with a completeness result for do-calculus.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace C(R,Q) by a criterion that treats observational data as the mechanism-recovery regime for roots, and prove necessity separately for missing parent-value support and missing full-outcome support; include explicit witnesses for both failure modes.

Restrict the statistical target to a named compact intervention class Q0 and a declared smooth AOI class for b, then state the design/support geometry and empirical-process conditions needed before asking for an influence function or uniform bootstrap.

Correct Jeunen citations from “Theorem 3” to the applicable Theorem 1 or 2, correct the TMLR title to its published form, and label the Gaussian reduction solely as a regression corollary rather than a novel proposition.

recommended_next_step: Return to Stage -1: replace the false iff-cover headline before advancing; the full-law sufficiency route may be retained only after the root and missing-outcome-support necessity cases are reformulated.
